title: SPECTRE modeled on ODESSA

tellings.quote: it's very obviously the organization which was known to Ian Fleming as Odessa.

plain: SPECTRE, the made-up criminal organisation in the James Bond spy novels by the writer Ian Fleming, was really based on a group Fleming knew as ODESSA, a secret network that the claim ties to the end of the Second World War in 1945. Jason Jorjani, a researcher who says he has found a secret Nazi UFO programme, makes this case to Jesse Michels without naming a source, and he links the network to two figures from Hitler's circle, the aide Martin Bormann and the commando Otto Skorzeny. If he is right, the Bond books were hiding a real postwar Nazi network in plain sight.
